product: GPM IMERG Late Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree (GPM_3IMERGDL.07)
licence: NASA open data: no restrictions on reuse, cite the dataset DOI (EOSDIS data use guidance)
maturity: Late run (near real time, no gauge adjustment)
notes: 3805 of 3805 UTC days, 11 yearly stacks of 20 x 25 cells. Each band is the day's mean rate in mm/h (x 24 for mm). Days are UTC; Nepal is UTC+5:45. Each day was published about 14 h after it ended (days.csv), which a backtest must respect. 0 cell-days have fewer than half their half-hourly retrievals. History is the V07 reprocessing, not the values issued at the time.
